basics.name: Archith Sharma
basics.summary: Currently employed at Carnegie Mellon University. Student Developer + Researcher @ CMU :)

work.company: CMU Heinz College of Information Systems and Public Policy
highlights: Ongoing research with Dr. Woody Zhu on deep-learning methods in earthquake detection
Developing an extension of CUSUM (Cumulative Sum Statistic for distribution change) to multiple data sources — see the [CUSUM Portal](/projects/cusum-portal/) project page
Supported by the CMU Summer Undergraduate Research Fellowship (SURF)
Conducted research with Dr. Junhyeon Kwon on bird population models for conservation action

Developed a synthetic simulation framework and ARMA & ARDL time-series tools using R and R Markdown — published as [Modeling American Kestrel Decline Using Spatiotemporal Subsampling to Improve eBird Data Reliability](/publication/2025-01-02-kestrel-decline-ebird-subsampling)

publications.name: Modeling American Kestrel Decline Using Spatiotemporal Subsampling to Improve eBird Data Reliability
publications.summary: Debiases eBird citizen-science data with spatiotemporal subsampling, then uses a time-series model to test whether rising Cooper's Hawk numbers help explain the American Kestrel decline.

publications.name: Stats & Stumps: Using Machine Learning to Predict T20I Matches with Player and Venue Data
publications.summary: Predicts Twenty20 International outcomes from venue-adjusted, player-level impact metrics. Regularized logistic regression reached 70.24% test accuracy on 1,029 matches.

presentations.name: Relationship lessons from the stock market
presentations.description: The similarities between investing in the stock market and success in human relationships.

projects.name: Allegheny Land Trust: St. John's Citizen Science Analysis
projects.description: A data-for-good project with CMU Students Using Data for Good, measuring whether citizen-science activity around the Allegheny Land Trust's St. John's project has grown faster than state and county baselines. [Download the write-up (PDF)](/files/allegheny-land-trust-st-johns-analysis.pdf)

projects.name: CUSUM Portal: Spatio-Temporal Earthquake Anomaly Detection
projects.description: An in-progress anomaly-detection portal that flags abnormal seismic swarms in live USGS earthquake data using spatio-temporal CUSUM change detection. Research with Dr. Woody Zhu, supported by SURF.

projects.name: Geospatial Mobile Application for Emergency Response and Management
projects.description: A location-based AR app for navigation and emergency response on the UNT campus, built on Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles and Cesium for Unity. Research in UNT's Data Visualization and eXtended Reality (DVXR) Lab.

projects.name: NFL Big Data Bowl 2026: Ball Hawks
projects.description: Measuring a defender's commitment to the ball when it is in the air and its impact on play outcomes. Submitted to the NFL Big Data Bowl on Kaggle.

projects.name: TAMS Mock Election 2024
projects.description: A student-run mock election at the Texas Academy of Mathematics and Science: 115 voters, Texas-style ballot ordering, and a look at what ranked-choice voting can and can't fix. [Download the results write-up (PDF)](/files/tams-mock-election-results-2024.pdf)
